thread:
leah (CS): starting a thread for SierraBridge day0 private deployment. top blockers reported by devon: CMK import mechanics, VPC endpoint policy for S3 (they want logs never traverse internet), and CloudWatch Flow Logs delivery into their SIEM. also they're anxious about the audit ingestion SLA — asked for a formal runbook.
jamal (SRE): quick read of their terraform: they created interface endpoints for s3 and kinesis but the endpoint policy is permissive to the whole org. we should propose a least-priv policy scoped to the bucket + redwood service principal.
priya (Solutions): regarding KMS: we can either do an imported key (they brought a wrapped key) or create a customer-managed key and set key policy to allow their security team and our redwood-priv-role. devon, did you get the wrapped key with the import token?
devon (SierraBridge): yes wrapped_blob.bin uploaded to s3://sierra-sec/keys/ but token was sent separately over the secure transfer. security says they'll only share after we sign the NDA amendment.
sage (AE): timeline note: customer tied next renewal discount to audit readiness for Prod by end-of-month. if logs aren't validated, renewal asks go back to procurement and risk increases. marking potential renewal risk.
leah (CS): OK we need an actionable plan. propose P0: a) finalize CMK import and verify encryption-on-rest for logs, b) lock down S3 endpoint policy, c) establish Flow Logs -> Kinesis Firehose -> their SIEM with buffering, d) smoke test ingestion within 30m for 90% of events. agree?
jamal (SRE): agreed. I'm drafting the IAM trust policy we'll use for cross-account role. snippet: ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::765432109876:role/redwood-priv"},
    "Action":["sts:AssumeRole"],
    "Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:RequestedRegion":"us-west-2"}}
  }]
}
```
priya (Solutions): for the S3 endpoint: use an endpoint policy that only allows s3:PutObject to the designated audit bucket with the condition aws:SourceVpce referencing their VPC endpoint id. i'll paste a template after this thread.
infra-bot: ticket CB-8802 created and linked: https://tickets.internal/CB-8802 assigned to jamal, priya (automated).
devon (SierraBridge): signed NDA amendment just sent to sage. once it's countersigned, we'll release the import token.
leah (CS): capture: onboarding health = yellow because of token gating + renewal tie. we should schedule exec sync if token not released in 24h.
j amal (SRE): once token is in place i'll run the import: steps are 1) kms import-key-material --key-id <id> --wrapped-key-material fileb://wrapped_blob.bin --import-token fileb://import_token.bin 2) kms update-key-description 3) describe-key to ensure KeyState=Enabled. i'll post output.
priya (Solutions): runbook for Flow Logs path (high level): create flow log (destination: kinesis-data-firehose) -> delivery stream set to splunk HEC (use HEC token) -> enable S3 backup with CMK encryption -> lambda transform for enrichment + dedupe -> monitor with CloudWatch alarm on DeliveryToS3. i'll attach the json policy for the transform lambda config after demo.
devon (SierraBridge): Splunk team requires a proof of delivery for retention and will run their own validation. can you provide a short test harness?
priya (Solutions): yes, we'll push a harness that sends 500 events with randomized flows, verify through delivery metrics, and give a validation checklist.
jamal (SRE): import succeeded after token arrived. logs: "ImportKeyMaterial completed", KeyState: Enabled. starting assume-role test across accounts now.
jamal (SRE): assume-role OK: "Assumed role arn:aws:iam::765432109876:role/redwood-priv at 2026-03-21T15:03:12Z". next: update endpoint policy.
priya (Solutions): endpoint policy template: ```json
{
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal": "*",
    "Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:PutObjectAcl"],
    "Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::sierra-audit-logs/*"],
    "Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:sourceVpce":"vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h"}}
  }]
}
```
leah (CS): priya, can you run the Flow Logs harness and drop the telemetry link here? we'll need evidence for the AE and the renewal committee.
priya (Solutions): kicking harness now -> sending 500 test events -> monitoring.
infra-bot: smoke-run CB-8802: 500 events sent, delivered to Splunk index sierra-prod, median latency 22s, 98% within 30m. telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/runs/CB-8802 (automated)
devon (SierraBridge): Splunk ops confirms receipt in sierra-prod and retention tags are set. they asked for the S3 backup path to be s3://sierra-audit-backup/ with server-side encryption using our CMK.
jamal (SRE): updated delivery stream backup bucket + configured CMK ARN in Firehose. tested S3 write permissions from assume-role -> OK.
leah (CS): great. updating onboarding tracker: CMK import complete , IAM assume-role tested , S3 endpoint policy applied , Flow Logs ingestion smoke pass . closing notes: final action - devon to confirm Splunk whitelist done and AE to mark renewal risk resolved.
sage (AE): I'll update renewal risk to 'mitigated' pending their whitelist confirmation. thanks team. :thumbsup:
